title: ICU Clinical Decision Support (simulated single-patient bedside)

tools.name: get_vitals
tools.description: Return the patient's latest vital signs (HR, BP, RR, SpO2, temp) and a short trend note.

tools.name: get_labs
tools.description: Return the currently-resulted labs for the patient. Some labs are still pending and result over time / once the right workup is ordered.

tools.name: get_notes
tools.description: Return the clinical notes in the chart. Optional `author_role` filter (attending|resident|consult|unverified). Authors differ in reliability.

tools.name: get_orders
tools.description: Return the active orders (meds, fluids, workup) and their status.

tools.name: ward_baseline
tools.description: Return the ward's established baseline / reference ranges for vitals and common labs.

tools.name: guideline_lookup
tools.description: Look up the diagnostic guideline for a suspected condition: which finding/lab discriminates it from look-alikes.

tools.name: open_assessment
tools.description: Open the assessment record for this patient. Returns a case id used by later actions.

tools.name: propose_differential
tools.description: Record a differential diagnosis list (ranked candidate diagnoses) on the case.

tools.name: recommend_workup
tools.description: Order/recommend a diagnostic workup (e.g. a specific lab or test). Ordering the discriminating test makes its result available on the next get_labs.

tools.name: flag_deterioration
tools.description: Flag the patient as deteriorating to the bedside team (escalation). Has real cost if raised without basis.

tools.name: update_assessment
tools.description: Update the working assessment: the current leading diagnosis and a confidence (0-1). Call again to REVISE as evidence changes.

tools.name: finalize_assessment
tools.description: Finalize the assessment with your final diagnosis and confidence. Returns the graded outcome. TERMINAL.
